identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime][bug] Make agent-to-agent initiation first-class in live Observatory

values.goal: Make model-backed resident agents initiate governed agent-to-agent contact through a first-class Runtime action path.
values.required_outcome: Beacon Axioma can initiate a governed turn to Ember Axioma through the live-style Observatory/Shepherd path without relying on natural-language roleplay or direct test-only primitive calls.

Runtime policy, Layer8 signing, admission, replay, cancellation, and recipient/provider failure remain authoritative
C-SDLC v2 remains the live lifecycle authority until explicit V3-F/#505 cutover
operator_constraints: Never write tracked issue work on main
Do not use AWS, paid runners, or live cloud/provider calls without explicit authorization
Do not hide A2A behind prompt wording alone
